items.summary:
Một số chuyên gia cho rằng các công ty trung tm dữ liệu mới nổi có thể gặp khó khăn về vốn nếu các quy định chặt chẽ hơn làm chậm tiến độ các dự án xy dựng mới. Các công ty này đã dựa vào khoản vay để mở rộng kinh doanh.  
   
Nguồn tin thị trường cho biết điều đó có nghĩa là cổ phiếu công nghệ có thể vẫn bất ổn trong thời gian trước mắt. Điều này khiến cổ phiếu công nghệ cao của Mỹ biến động.  
   
Đảng Dn chủ đã giành lại quyền kiểm soát cả hai viện Quốc hội trong cuộc bầu cử tuần trước. Các ứng viên đảng Dn chủ cũng chiến thắng trong các cuộc bầu cử thống đốc ở nhiều bang, trong đó có Texas, nơi có nhiều trung tm dữ liệu.

items.title: Elon Musk: 'Công nghệ Neuralink có thể chữa mù' - Báo VnExpress
items.summary: Theo Tom's Hardware, Blindsight khác với đa số công nghệ hiện nay, vốn tập trung vào truyền tín hiệu từ não bộ để điều khiển thiết bị bên ngoài. Ví dụ, ốc tai điện tử và thiết bị cấy ghép thần kinh cảm giác gửi tín hiệu từ cảm biến vào não, giúp người khiếm thính nghe lại và bệnh nhn lấy lại xúc giác. Trong khi đó, Blindsight hướng đến thiết lập đường dẫn thị giác nhn tạo, cho phép bệnh nhn dùng camera để thu thập hình ảnh, sau đó chuyển đổi tín hiệu thành dạng mà não bộ hiểu được thông qua [...] Dù không phải công ty đầu tiên nghiên cứu về giao diện não - máy tính, Neuralink là một trong những tên tuổi thành công nhất, phần nào nhờ hỗ trợ tài chính từ Musk. Một số doanh nghiệp khác cũng nỗ lực nghiên cứu công nghệ tương tự. Ví dụ, Meta phát triển máy quét điện não đồ từ trường không xm lấn cho phép người dùng chuyển suy nghĩ thành những thao tác nhấn phím, trong khi startup Trung Quốc NeuroXess, thành lập năm 2021, đang đẩy nhanh tiến độ để thử nghiệm trên người trong năm nay. [...] Neuralink đã tiến hành một số thử nghiệm công nghệ cho người bị tổn thương tủy sống, bệnh xơ cứng teo cơ một bên (ALS) và bệnh lý khác. Vài năm gần đy, công ty cũng công bố một số ca cấy ghép não. Hồi tháng 1, Neuralink cho biết có 21 người đã tham gia thử nghiệm trên toàn thế giới.

items.title: New model helps robots learn tasks faster with less human programming
items.summary:
Called agentic robotics, the approach allows teams of AI agents to generate robot-control programs, test them in simulated environments, identify failures, and revise their code before deploying it on physical machines.

The technology could address two longstanding challenges in robotics: the extensive engineering required to program robot behaviors and the large volumes of real-world data needed to train robots through imitation learning. [...] Agentic robotics seeks to combine the advantages of these methods while reducing their limitations. The approach uses a framework called Graph-as-Policy, which divides complex robotic tasks into smaller, reusable skills. These include identifying objects, planning grasps, and moving robotic grippers without colliding with surrounding objects. [...] UC Berkeley researchers have developed an AI-driven approach that could significantly accelerate how robots are programmed and trained for real-world tasks. Called agentic robotics, the approach uses teams of AI agents to generate robot-control programs, test them in simulated environments, and refine their performance.

The method could reduce the need for extensive training data and manual engineering, two major challenges that have slowed the development of capable robots.

items.title: Robots could transform breast surgery forever | Vox
items.summary:
In a traditional mastectomy, the surgical cut is held physically open with instruments called retractors, which can cause considerable physical trauma and pressure in the area around it. By contrast, in robotic surgery, carbon dioxide gas is used to open up the space in a much gentler manner. Farr believes that reduced trauma to the skin and better visualization of structures (and hence increased ability to avoid critical nerves) in robot-assisted surgery could be the reason that some patients [...] In a robotic mastectomy, the surgeon sits at a console a few feet away from the patient and controls every movement of the machine’s instruments with their hands. The da Vinci single-port robot, the version cleared for nipple-sparing mastectomies, has one arm that enters the body through a single small incision usually along the side of the chest or, in some cases, in the fold beneath the breast. The arm has three multi-jointed instruments at one end, which the surgeon can use to bend, grasp, [...] Some surgeons are embracing this new technology because it offers a smaller, hidden scar and a clearer view inside the breast. Some patients also report better sensation in the chest area afterward.
 But critics say that there isn’t conclusive long-term evidence yet that robotic nipple-sparing mastectomies are as good as open mastectomies at making sure the cancer doesn’t come back, even if they are technically safe to perform.

At OpenAI, the bigger picture is always in focus.

“With US data centre capacity projected to exceed 100 gigawatts by 2030⁠, we have a once-in-a-generation opportunity to strengthen the electric grid by building campuses that can adjust their power use when communities need it most,” the company says. [...] OpenAI is working to ensure its data centres can actually benefit grids, rather than overloading them. Credit: Anna Moneymaker/Getty

## What is OpenAI’s Grid Protectors Program?

items.title: OpenAI wants to be Google - Fast Company
items.summary:
OpenAI needs to build analytics that show advertisers the consumer intent based on their prompts. I want to know which categories of intent my impressions ran against. I want to know whether those people were exploring, comparing, or ready to act, and which needs and product criteria drove that engagement. I want to know which kinds of sweater prompts turned into business and, just as important, which didn’t. Google’s advertisers have had some version of that map for two decades. It’s why [...] |

That comparison is where every sweater brand wants to be standing, and OpenAI has started selling the spot. Advertisers can buy on a CPM or CPC basis through OpenAI’s beta self-service Ads Manager, measure conversions with a pixel and Conversions API, and access campaign-level performance reporting. OpenAI is also testing Sponsored Agents, which let a user start a separate conversation with an advertiser after clicking an ad.

So the plumbing exists.

## A SEARCH-CALIBER AD PLATFORM [...] OpenAI already has the hard part down, the thing Google spent years teaching people to do. People are telling ChatGPT their goals, problems, preferences, objections, and purchase criteria in their own words. What it hasn’t built is the advertiser’s map of all that intent.

items.title: Anthropic and OpenAI are coming for the development workflow | InfoWorld
items.summary: This is clearly where the frontier labs are moving, even though they’ve all benefited from an industry that provided neutral spaces to build. For example, OpenAI developed Pando, a Git back end for its own monorepo, to handle more engineers and agents reading and writing code concurrently. Its engineers kept using Git. OpenAI retained compatibility with the protocol and client and contributed improvements upstream. That compatibility let it rebuild the back end around the way its engineers [...] This pressure to maximize profitability helps explain why frontier labs like Anthropic and OpenAI are aggressively adding functionality to own more of the developer’s workflow. On November 4, OpenAI announced an agreement to buy Pierre, the company behind Code Storage and the open source libraries Codex already uses to browse files and review changes. OpenAI wants Codex to be where developers work, from the first branch an agent creates through deployment of the application. There’s money in [...] OpenAI or Anthropic could build the place developers prefer to work. The question is what happens when a team likes that place and wants a rival’s agent for a particular job. Maybe a startup has built a tool that can track down the intermittent test failure that’s had the team stumped for a week. Give it access to the code and test history the team has authorized, and it gets a chance to prove itself. Ask the team to move its work to a new platform first, and it probably never gets to try.
